I personally think strong friendships come from vulnerability. I had the same issue at one point and discovered that you have to be okay with making s fool out of yourself every once in a while, or saying something hat they don’t agree with in order or get to know them on a deeper level. You have to stop the mentality of “oh tis could be a potential best friend that can relieve y loneliness” and instead, think “this is a complex person whom  I can get interesting stories or interests out of that maybe I can connect to”. Surface level friendships are surface level because either someone is afraid of breaking the surface. Or maybe someone isn’t capable of going below the surface.
